text_block_list.name: Flight & Bakushin
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Haa...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan...!! I won't let you 
pass...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Because the raw materials that make up 
'me'...! Are wonderful! Haaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Sprint King has been decided! 
The winner is... North Flight! It's North 
Flight!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I beat Bakushin O-chan in speed—I won!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I lost... Flight-san really is strong!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "...Could she possibly be even fast—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Grit...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Barely?
(Uwooooah...!)

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san, congrats! To think you took 
down the great Bakushin O-san!

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san really is Bakushin O-san's 
rival!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I see, even Bakushin O has... a rival. 
Even though I thought she'd never lose in 
speed—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we're gonna see an even hotter 
showdown from here on...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, I see. A brilliance that brings 
out the best in each other..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"This is... irresistibly cute. And on top 
of that—Bakushin O-san's incredible speed 
that made Flight-san stand out even more!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That light that captivates you in an 
instant! It's absolutely perfect for 
Curren♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Curren can find a good rival 
too? I think I'll go look for one♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see... so this is...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha. Bwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating! This is simply fascinating, 
Flight-san—!

North Flight secured a magnificent victory 
over Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"With everything I had, I reached Bakushin 
O-chan!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy that I won, but... my heart is 
just so full..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“It feels like my individuality has 
clicked right into place...”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I really want to shine the brightest on 
the sprint track!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Still... as expected, Bakushin O-chan was 
really strong.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Just because we won doesn't mean we can 
let our guard down. We have to work even 
harder!
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flight-san... Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
choice_data_list:
(Something about her feels... different 
than usual?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was defeated. You were more 
magnificent... and faster.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's why... That's why...—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Bakushin O-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For the first time, I understand. So this 
is what jealousy feels like.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The thought that someone else might be 
faster... had never even crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"However, your speed... made my teeth 
grind with envy."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —I knew it was you! It really is you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The one worthy of being a rival to me—the 
supreme class representative—is none other 
than...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was about time she conquered 
other GⅠs as well... but it proved to be 
premature.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It seems that you and I must Bakushin even 
harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Next time— let's meet at the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Next time... I'll make you feel 
envious again.

"The Yasuda Kinen—a Mile G1 held in 
June... Renowned Umamusume throughout 
history have claimed victory here, and 
international Umamusume set their sights 
on it too."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: 1,600m――my stage.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Dressed in my best coordination, I can 
compete against the Bakushin O of today."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose. Next time too, without 
fail...!

The fighting spirit North Flight displayed 
had grown even stronger. If so, to ensure 
victory in the Yasuda Kinen—
choice_data_list: How about entering the Milers Cup?

text_block_list.text:
Just as its name suggests, it's a mile 
race, and many Umamusume use it to get 
into peak condition before heading to the 
Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's just like during the Fuchu Umamusume 
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Because I figured out my look there... I 
was able to deliver a wonderful run in the 
Shuka Sho.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's be even more fabulous!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's go for... the Milers Cup!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy. That you're suggesting 
additional races to me."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
North Flight
text_block_list.text: I've... gotten stronger, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —I'll be waiting for you, Bakushin O-chan!

Before the primary goal, the Yasuda Kinen, 
where Sakura Bakushin O awaits, we will 
use the Yomiuri Milers Cup for 
fine-tuning.
